_doc: SARD_AGENTIC_SECURITY_PRD.md §58 — pinned dataset sources. Java/C# Juliet are pinned via git SHA in scanner/test/benchmark/realworld/manifest.json (repo+sha there is the equivalent lock for those two); this file covers sources that don't go through that harness. SHA-256 values here were computed locally after download, never trusted from a third-party quote (see root CLAUDE.md verification-discipline rule).

sard-php-vulnerability-test-suite.author: Bertrand Stivalet and Aurelien Delaitre (NIST SARD test-suite #103)
sard-php-vulnerability-test-suite.license: public-domain (US Govt work, CC0-equivalent per SARD terms)
sard-php-vulnerability-test-suite.structure: one <numericId>-v1.0.0/ directory per test case, each with manifest.sarif (SARIF 2.1.0 ground truth: properties.state good|bad, results[].ruleId=CWE-<N>, results[].locations[].physicalLocation.region.startLine), Dockerfile, Makefile, and src/<CWE-and-descriptor-bearing-filename>.php.
sard-php-vulnerability-test-suite.verifiedBy: curl -I HTTP 200 + content-length match, then `shasum -a 256` on the actual downloaded bytes, both this session — not a third-party-quoted checksum.
